primary_citation: 47 C.F.R. Part 64, Subpart U (CPNI Rules); implementing 47 U.S.C. §222 (Telecommunications Act of 1996, Pub. L. 104-104)
original_enactment: Telecommunications Act of 1996, Pub. L. 104-104, §702 (adding 47 U.S.C. §222); FCC CPNI Order implementing rules (1999)
significant_amendments: FCC 07-22 (2007) — comprehensive CPNI order; strengthened authentication requirements; addressed pretexting and social engineering
FCC 23-67 (2023) — SIM swap specific action; additional carrier obligations for SIM swap fraud prevention
civil_remedy_note: No private right of action directly under 47 U.S.C. §222. Civil liability through: (1) negligence/negligence per se, (2) California UCL §17200 unlawful prong, (3) California negligence §1714. FCC enforcement through 47 U.S.C. §503(b) forfeiture
